class: Personal-profile correction overrides a repeated entry
symptom: The generic correction loop repeatedly replaced the saved school city Charleston with the home city Fairfax.
site: Church Mutual ADP Senior Network Engineer application 548, supervised continuation 26 October 2026
root_cause: The initial detail-field correction and planner mismatch correction did not exclude controls already mapped to a job or degree. Normal residence resolution was entry-aware, but these earlier correction paths were not.
why_tests_missed: A synthetic test without a successful open-answer review hid the write; reproducing the reviewed correction path exposed it.
fix: Exclude mapped repeated-entry controls from personal-profile correction; keep scoped repeated-history corrections.
prevention: Cover complete portal-shaped workflows and verify committed answers against the correct personal, employer or school scope; preserve owner values and final-submission gates.
